_comment: The offline practice questions. Wording lives here so a teacher can change how a question is asked without touching code. {name} is filled in from the sentence's analysis.
_key_roles_comment: Which role the second question prefers to ask about, the subject of a sentence is the most useful thing to name first. Written both ways because the rule engine may label either.
_case_types_comment: Only these word types carry a visible case ending worth asking about.

sentence_type.question: What type of sentence is: «{sentence}»?
sentence_type.hint: Look at the first word, is it a verb (fi'l) or a noun (ism)?

key_role.question: What is the grammatical role (إعراب) of «{word}»?

case_sign.question: What is the case (حالة الإعراب) and its sign (علامة الإعراب) of «{word}»?
case_sign.hint: Think about which case ending it takes.

full_iraab.question: Write the full I'raab (إعراب) of the sentence: «{sentence}» word by word.
full_iraab.hint: Work through the sentence word by word, naming each word's role and case.

_missing_comment: Printed wherever the analysis had nothing to put in a slot.
